headline: Content class impacts multiple Textual components
what_breaks: src/textual/app.py — relies on Content for rendering text
src/textual/widget.py — uses Content for widget text management
src/textual/visual.py — depends on Content for visual representation
why: The Content class is central to text handling in the Textual framework, affecting various components that rely on it for rendering and styling. Changes to its implementation could lead to widespread issues across dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to Content class methods and properties
Check interactions with Span class for any breaking changes
Ensure compatibility with rich.text and other imported modules
